E.29 section 3.2 measured daily-return correlations only for CL-ZM, CL-GC, CL-NQ, ZM-GC, ZM-NQ, GC-NQ (2022-11-01..2023-10-31): none pairs two pool members, so r3_score uses its rule (0.5 within an asset class). K_test = K_year x 870 / 252 (continuous: n_cap(h_c) x 870); n_per_day = K_year / 252.
